R20.evidence: HOVER half passes: the size is one dotted-underlined number and hovering it opens 'What this needs' — Model file 4.8 GB / Vision file (sees images) 0.9 GB / Download 5.7 GB / Memory while running 6.2 GB / includes 0.5 GB for a 32k context. Shot: /home/destin/youcoded-dev/scratch/le-accept/real/size-bubble-hover.png. TAP half FAILS. With Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled on, a real touch tap on the number fires pointerdown, touchstart, pointerup, touchend, mouseover, mouseenter, focus, click, mouseout, mouseleave — AnchorTip's hover mode opens on mouseenter/focus and closes on mouseleave, so the trailing mouseleave shuts the bubble in the same frame. Polled every 60 ms for 1.5 s after the tap: the bubble was never once on screen ([0,0,0,…]), while a programmatic .focus() on the same button opens it. The same is true of the eye/page marks. Destin uses a touchscreen, so on his machine the breakdown is hover-only in practice.
